tokens.v: The tote rides in the wicker basket of a parked city bike on a cobbled market street, ranunculus stems and a paper-wrapped baguette leaning out of it, morning sun skimming the tan leather so the grain and the brass feet catch. 50mm at f/2 at basket height, the handlebar and bell blurring through the top-left corner, a striped market awning and moving shoppers dissolved behind. ROWAN ASH sits blind-debossed beneath the handle root, shadow pooling in the impression. A crate of lemons burns yellow out of focus in the near-right, cut by the edge.
